title: Marcos orders fast-tracking of energy projects ahead of ‘Super’ El Niño

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered the energy department to expedite completion of energy projects across the country as part of the government’s preparation for the anticipated drought from a “very strong” El Niño.
